question: Can Tracee's native object be built from untouched upstream source?

obstacles.why: BPF backend marker; returns V unchanged. x86 codegen fails with 'Cannot select: intrinsic %llvm.bpf.passthrough'.
obstacles.fix: fold each call to its argument, per function (SSA names repeat across functions)

obstacles.why: a bare compiler barrier, no data
the verifier idiom clamping a size register to an immediate; no output operand, so in SSA every later use of the value must see the clamp
obstacles.fix: llvm.smin of the value and the bound, applied to later uses

obstacles.why: common.h's update_min, which does have an output

notes: Tracee's vmlinux.h is IDENTICAL to upstream: the layout claim posted earlier (native task_struct offsets 4/8/20/32/48/112/144) is about the trimmed header's content, not a tree modification, so it is a CO-RE question (P1h), not a same-source one.
The three source files that do differ (common/buffer.h, common/common.h, common/filesystem.h) differ only by MICRO_NATIVE guards around exactly these asm idioms.
The fix must be function-scoped: the first attempt used a whole-file alias map and produced a type error when %4 meant an i64 in one function and a ptr in another.
state: compiles to x86 from untouched source; two linker gaps remain

reached.x86 object: tracee.same.native.o, 8,135,776 bytes, 172 defined text symbols, 0 SSE instructions
reached.compiled from: untouched vendor/repos/tracee source + headers (BPF target, -emit-llvm), then the four idioms folded out, then x86 codegen
reached.cost: lowering pass 2.4 s, x86 codegen 20.7 s

remaining.linker says: PC32 proof section-symbol target .maps is not rodata/bss
remaining.note: the shipped build reaches the map through a GOTPCRELX load whose slot the loader fills (kind 5); here clang emitted a PC32 against the section symbol because the IR has no dso_local/GOT distinction. Katran needed -fPIC at the frontend for the same reason; the Tracee frontend is the BPF target, so the fix belongs in the linker (accept a PC32 .maps reference as a map-pointer relocation).

remaining.linker says: x86 unresolved register-indirect call in trace_sys_enter at local offset 0x34a through ...
remaining.note: the IR carries helpers as `inttoptr (i64 35 to ptr)()`. clang hoisted the constant into a register and the linker's helper-site scan expects the immediate form the shipped object has (mov $imm32, %eax; call *%rax against an R_X86_64_PLT32/helper relocation).
